mod.name: Resize & Drag Window
mod.author: zolantris
mod.description: Drag and scale Inventory, Chests, Crafting Stations, and Pause menus with persistent per-panel memory.

settings.label: Enable Resize & Drag Window
settings.description: Master toggle for panel dragging and scaling.

settings.label: Enable Middle-Mouse Drag
settings.description: Hold Middle Mouse Button while a panel is open to drag it.

settings.label: Enable Alt + Arrow Key Move
settings.description: Use Alt + Arrow Keys to nudge the open panel.

settings.label: Enable Alt + Wheel / NumPad Resize
settings.description: Use Alt + Mouse Wheel or Alt + NumPad +/- to scale the open panel.

settings.label: Keyboard Nudge Step (px)
settings.description: Pixels moved per Alt + Arrow Key press.

settings.label: Resize Step
settings.description: Scale increment per wheel tick or Alt + NumPad +/- press.

settings.label: Allow Crafting & Processing Stations
settings.description: Enable drag/resize on Crafting, Smelting, Composter, and Enchanting panels.

settings.label: Allow Build & Spellcasting Menus
settings.description: Enable drag/resize on Building and Spellcasting menus.
